description: This PHP source file defines the 'CaseFeed' class, which extends 'FeedLogicBase'. The class is responsible for generating and pushing feed updates related to 'Cases' in the SuiteCRM system. It includes a method 'pushFeed' that constructs notification messages when a case is created or closed.

classes.name: CaseFeed
classes.description: A class that handles creating and pushing activity feeds related to 'Case' records in the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: Generates a feed message based on the creation or closure of a case, and pushes the feed if applicable.
